visual_text: SYMBAD trial, 204 people with Alzheimer's disease
Mirtazapine for agitation: no clear benefit
Agitation at 12 weeks: no clear difference SCHEMATIC
Both groups improved in the first 6 weeks
Difference tested after the trial; too few deaths to be sure of cause
alt_text: Two panels. Schematic sketch: agitation lines for mirtazapine and dummy tablet fall together over 12 weeks, no clear difference. Icon arrays of 102 squares each: 1 filled for the dummy tablet, 7 filled for mirtazapine, deaths by 16 weeks. Note: tested after the trial, too few deaths to be sure of cause.
design_instructions: Single 4:5 light card. Panel 1 schematic (labelled Schematic, no numeric axis): solid teal and dotted orange near-identical falling lines with keys. Panel 2 two 10-wide arrays of 102 squares, dummy tablet first (1 filled), mirtazapine (7 filled), orange fill vs pale grey. Claims C08-15-b, c.
